 Lauren Anderson Tue, November 17, 2026 at 4:34 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Lainey Wilson Plans Bedazzled Broom for Ella Langley’s CMA Award Wins Lainey Wilson is ready to help Ella Langley celebrate if she has a big night at the 2026 CMA Awards.
 And she has a pretty sparkly idea for how to do it.
 Wilson, 34, who is returning to host the awards for the third consecutive year, recently shared a playful plan for her fellow country star during an appearance on Amazon Music's Country Heat Weekly podcast . With Langley leading this year's nominees, Wilson joked that she might need to bring along some special equipment if the 27-year-old singer starts collecting trophies.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "I am gathering ideas and I'll tell you one of my ideas because I told Ella this," Wilson said during the conversation with hosts Kelly Sutton and Amber Anderson . "I said, 'Girl, I'm going to bring you a bedazzled broom' so she can sweep it up."
 And Wilson wasn't stopping there.
 She added that she'd be ready with a matching accessory, too: "I'm going to be there with a bedazzled dust pan."
 It's a fitting joke considering Langley's impressive year.
 The "Choosin' Texas" singer leads the field at the 60th annual CMA Awards with nine nominations , including Entertainer of the Year, Female Vocalist of the Year and Album of the Year for Dandelion . She also earned multiple nominations for "Be Her" and "Choosin' Texas."
 Advertisement Advertisement Wilson, meanwhile, is nominated for three awards of her own: Entertainer of the Year, Female Vocalist of the Year and Single of the Year for "Somewhere Over Laredo."
 The two singers are among the nominees competing for some of country music's biggest honors, but Wilson's comments make it clear she's also looking forward to celebrating her fellow artists.
 The 2026 CMA Awards take place Wednesday, Nov. 18, at Nashville's Bridgestone Arena. Wilson will host the milestone 60th ceremony, which airs live on ABC and Disney+.
 Whether her bedazzled broom makes an appearance onstage remains to be seen. But if Langley does have a night full of wins, Wilson may want to keep that dustpan close.
